notes: Design is not named; cross-sectional inferred from the annual NHIS survey, with trend added for the 2019–2020 headline change. The Figure 2 trend model is unnamed, so its family is recorded as other. Urban-rural tests within each race group are tests of rurality within race levels, not tests across race, so they make no groupwise entry.
view_issues: The 'higher among' group comparisons have no stated test or overlap rule; only 2019–2020 changes, urban-rural by race, and per-day trends are said to be tested. The text says 'past-year prevalence' for current-use changes, and Figure 2 note has the typo 'deceased'.
